data.name: Tranquil Guard Flowing Form
data.description: Honed through years of practising the staff, stand firm as you block all incoming damage.
data.battleDescription: %user flows into Tranquil Guard, staff held firm as a steady aura surrounds them. With each controlled strike, they deal measured damage while weakening %target’s power, their blows softened against the user’s guarded form.

data.name: Enduring Resonance Ward
data.battleDescription: %user raises their guard as a resonant aura hums around them. When %target strikes, the ward absorbs the blow and pulses outward, rebounding the force back and damaging %target in return.

data.name: Pivoting Fortress
data.description: The master once said, Footwork is the key, one must be fluid, flexible but not break
data.battleDescription: %user rotates from one stance to the next, fluid in motion and sure of step. Their strike lands without leaving room for reprisal.

data.name: Phantom Slash
data.battleDescription: %user flickers forward like a ghost, dagger gliding in a silent arc. The slash phases through %target’s guard, striking unseen, leaving behind a delayed, phantom cut that suddenly tears through them.

data.name: Crimson Thrust
data.battleDescription: %user grips their dagger as crimson chakra flares to life. In a brutal forward lunge, they drive the blade deep into %target, the impact bursting with violent force and searing intensity.

data.name: Shadow Pierce
data.battleDescription: %user vanishes into shadow, closing distance in silence. In a swift, lethal motion, they drive their dagger forward, piercing through %target with precision, the strike leaving a lingering, chilling pain.

data.name: Middle Guard Stance
data.battleDescription: %user shifts into Middle Guard Stance, centering their body and blade. Their presence hardens, boosting offense and defense while nullifying incoming debuffs, leaving %target unable to weaken their perfectly balanced form.

data.name: Harmonious Slash
data.description: A perfectly timed strike to punish the opponent
data.battleDescription: %user stands motionless, patiently reading %target’s attack. At the perfect instant, they strike, blade flashing, cutting through and reflecting the force back, punishing %target with their own power.

data.name: Vacuum Fan
data.battleDescription: %user creates a fan made of metallic chakra. With one motion of their hand, a vacuum is created on the battlefield that pulls everything towards %user

data.name: Inner Peace
data.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and takes a deep breath fortifying their offense and defense, and eerie stillness that causes their enemy to hesitate

data.name: Tetsugan
data.description: A rare bloodline that allows for control over metal

data.name: Liquid Ember Shell
data.description: Encases the user in a shell of molten fire and water.
data.battleDescription: %user merges fire and water chakra to form a molten liquid shell that absorbs attacks, with fire burning weaker assaults and water dissipating impacts, providing adaptive defense against various threats.

data.name: Drowning Strike
data.description: A fist of boiling water to the face.
data.battleDescription: %user covers their fist in scorching hot water before striking %target in the face, forcing most of that water down their nostrils.

data.name: Surfing Strike
data.description: A series of gliding movements atop boiling water
data.battleDescription: %user unleashes a torrent of water, flooding the battlefield. Using their Boil affinity, they glide seamlessly over the steaming surface, while the boiling water scalds %target causing %user to take less damage.

data.name: Scorch Break
data.description: Your most basic technique as a wielder of the Boil style
data.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into their palms, turning it into steaming liquid. Dashing forward, %user unleashes a flurry of punches, each strike searing %target's body and leaving burn marks in its wake.

data.name: Azure Dragon Palm
data.description: Land devasting blows from the safety of your dragon.
data.battleDescription: %user summons a water dragon that encases them like armor. Dashing toward %target, each strike they deliver is mirrored by the dragon, landing devastating blows that leave %target battered and overwhelmed.

data.name: Vaporia
data.description:
In the realm of myth and legend, tales of the Vaporia bloodline abound, each more fantastical than the last. Among the most enduring is the story of a mother who met her untimely end while traversing the uncharted eastern territories, cradling her infant in her arms. As she perished, her child was left alone upon the cold, unforgiving earth, wailing in despair. It is said that the anguished cries of the babe reached the ears of Seiryu, who, moved by pity for the hapless human, took it upon himself to nurture the child, infusing their essence with his divine blood.

 

Yet, beyond the old stories, one truth remains steadfast: the descendants of the Vaporia lineage possess an otherworldly mastery over the elements of water and fire. Coupled with their formidable prowess in Taijutsu, they wield these elements with unparalleled skill, seamlessly blending them at will. Legends may weave tales of divine intervention, but it is the tangible power and boundless potential of the Vaporia bloodline that commands awe and reverence throughout Seichi.
